items.label: NINJA SPIRIT/DCS
items.why: The disk autostarts this PRG. Its intro leads to the tape-counter prompt before the A load.

items.label: ANOTHER NOTE/DCS
items.why: Standalone DCS release note. Starting directory entry 2 directly displays a message from the cracking group. The normal boot route starts entry 1 and selects the four game packets with the A.* through D.* patterns.
